_note: Interest on a loan for an electric vehicle: an individual, "interest payable on loan taken by him from any financial institution for the purpose of purchase of an electric vehicle" (s.132(1), p.166), "subject to the condition that the loan has been sanctioned … during the period beginning on the 1st April, 2019 and ending on the 31st March, 2023" (s.132(2)), "shall not exceed ₹ 150000" (s.132(3), p.167). The same interest is not deductible under any other provision for the same or any other tax year (s.132(4)) — house-property interest under s.22(1)(b) must leave it out (W-078). rulebook DED-80EEB-001, DED-80EX-001. Old regime only (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227). TY 2026-27 and TY 2025-26; the 1961 counterpart, s.80EEB, is the TY 2025-26 version (W-075d4). D-139. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80EEB as inserted by F(No.2)A 2019 s.25 (p.17): an individual's interest payable on a loan from a financial institution "for the purpose of purchase of an electric vehicle", "(2) … shall not exceed one lakh and fifty thousand rupees"; (3) sanctioned "during the period beginning on the 1st day of April, 2019 and ending on the 31st day of March, 2023"; (4) no deduction of the same interest elsewhere — the same row. sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md M3. D-147. In every regime as a row; the new regime forbids it through DIS-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION, whose basis REG-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION (S2 s.202(2)(a); 1961 s.115BAC(2)(i)) every explanation cites (D-166).
